retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1960s album cover layout featuring a vignetted portrait against a cream background with a mix of bold extended sans-serif, casual script, and tall condensed typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, warm-toned portrait of a man in a straw hat and safari shirt, vignetted into a cream-colored field, surrounded by a hierarchical typographic lockup using three distinct font styles.
coreVisualRelationships: Portrait centered horizontally but anchored to the bottom edge
Bold extended header balanced by a right-aligned vertical text block
Warm yellow and tan tones in the subject contrasting with black and orange-red text
Soft vignetting blending the subject into the off-white background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central portrait, waist-up, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and straw hat serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top-left name, moves right to the script 'Sings', down to the orange title, and finally to the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample open space in the top corners and around the head to allow for metadata and titles.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for primary name and metadata
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted orange-red for the secondary title
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with warm, earthy tones in the photography and high-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of ultra-extended geometric sans, casual brush script, and tall condensed gothic.
letterConstructionRules: Primary name uses extreme horizontal expansion with thick, uniform strokes.
Secondary title uses high-waisted, condensed proportions with flat terminals.
Connecting text uses a fluid, slanted script with connected lowercase letters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended 'S' and 'E' in the header to emphasize width.
Tall, narrow 'S' and 'L' in the condensed title to maximize verticality.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast through width and style: ultra-wide sans paired with ultra-narrow sans and a fluid script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, wide header style.
Matches the tall, condensed title style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a straw hat and olive safari shirt, vignetted into a solid cream-colored background with ample negative space at the top and right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a bold extended black sans-serif at the top left. Add a script word to its right. Place the main title in tall, condensed orange-red letters stacked on the right side.

verificationChecks: Is the background a warm cream color?
Are there three distinct font styles used?
Is the portrait vignetted rather than hard-edged?

adjustableVariables: Accent color for the condensed title
postGenerationChecks: Check that the extended font is significantly wider than the condensed font.
Ensure the script font provides a visual 'bridge' between the two sans-serifs.
Verify the cream background is consistent and free of digital noise.
Confirm the portrait does not have a visible rectangular frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vignetted Portrait + Cream Field + (Extended Sans + Script + Condensed Sans) Hierarchy
